jobs.title: IT Program Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring an IT Program Manager who will be at the centre of how Moss buys, manages and eventually retires technology. You'll own the vendor and contract landscape, steer the Tech Operations budget, and lead the company-wide platform migrations and consolidations that come a few times a year. 

You'll report to the CISO and work closely with our Tech Operations engineers and Information Security team, alongside Legal, People Ops and FP&A, across a technology estate spanning 350 people and five offices.

Your responsibilities

 - Own vendor and contract negotiations across Moss's SaaS, tooling, infrastructure and connectivity providers, running competitive evaluations to build commercial leverage and maintaining the renewal calendar and contract repository

 - Plan and steer the Tech Operations budget, creating cost transparency per team and driving licence right-sizing, optimisation and consolidation across the tool estate

 - Partner with teams across Moss to understand how tools are actually used, matching licence tiers to real usage and deciding which overlapping tools to keep based on what genuinely serves people, not just cost

 - Drive down the number of tools Moss runs by finding shadow IT, bringing it into the process or consolidating it, and owning retirement work together with Information Security

 - Lead company-wide technology migrations and retirements end to end, from business case and migration plan through cutover, communication and training

 - Bring structure to how work reaches Tech Operations, building a clear intake process and owning the KPIs and monthly management reporting for the domain

 - Work with Legal on contracts and DPAs and with People Ops on joiners and leavers, owning the commercial relationship and negotiation for the vendors in your portfolio within Moss's existing Vendor Management framework

About you

 - Several years of experience in IT vendor management, procurement, sourcing, tech operations or IT service management, ideally gained in a scaling company

 - Proven experience negotiating with vendors and providers, including on service levels and cost

 - Experience leading at least one company-wide tool migration or consolidation end to end, including decommissioning the old system

 - A hands-on IT background, enough to keep essential services running from documented runbooks in an emergency

 - AI is core to how we work. We expect someone with an "AI Driver" toolkit: measurable, real-workflow AI use with concrete before/after impact, ideally including built automations or agents (n8n, Claude skills, or similar).

 - German at C1 or above, prior experience in a regulated environment (financial services, payments or e-money), exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2 or DORA, or an ITIL/IAITAM qualification are all a plus

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

 - A talent for moving things forward through clarity and good process rather than hierarchy

 - Comfortable owning commercial outcomes inside a governance framework someone else owns

 - Genuine curiosity about how other teams work, and translating that into better commercial calls than a dashboard would

 - A structured, documentation-friendly way of working, with an instinct for turning manual work into something that runs itself

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C  https://www.getmoss.com/magazine/moss-series-c?origin-page=en-us%2Fcareersled by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA https://www.linkedin.com/company/moss-finance/life/c2ac8184-5388-4962-ad07-e0bcbfe080f0/?viewAsMember=true: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

 - Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

 - Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

 - Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Join our Customer Success team, where you will focus on driving SaaS revenue growth through proactive customer engagement. While leveraging data insights, you will proactively identify upsell opportunities and mitigate churn risks. Your strategic guidance and deep product knowledge will be essential in helping customers unlock new value of our product and set them up for success. 

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

 - Drive customer engagement - through building and nurturing value-creating and scalable relationships, you develop a deep understanding of your clients’ and their finance goals. You guide and consult with them in order to drive their engagement and the activation of all the spend management features.

 - Upsell - you leverage your deep understanding of both the product and your customer's needs to identify new business opportunities, as well as product and feature optimisation initiatives to increase value for existing accounts. 

 - Measure success and provide data insights - with the use of specific KPIs you aim to achieve and monitor revenue trajectory through, for example, key metrics such as spend engagement, SaaS uplift and renewals.

 - Act as Product ambassador - working closely with internal stakeholders, you compile and communicate client feedback and act in an advisory capacity on current and future product features. 

 - Thrive for process excellence - you aim for continuous improvement, designing and delivering upon the client journey touchpoints that will increase customer satisfaction and contribute towards long-term retention.

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role:

 - Proven experience in a proactive commercial-centric role, ideally in a B2B setting.

 - Prior experience with upselling products and product features to existing clients.

 - Fluent in both German (C2) and English (C1).

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

 - Customer obsessed - You empathize with the needs and pain points of the customer and provide a flawless experience.

 - Commercially minded - You are able to demonstrate continuous value to customers, leveraging new business opportunities and can confidently negotiate pricing, contracts and add-ons.

 - Clear communicator - You are able to communicate complex topics to a range of audiences in a clear, concise and expert manner.

 - Analytical mindset - You are able to read, interpret and leverage data to prioritize customers, solve complex problems, identify upsell opportunities and retain customer happiness. You can recognise problems before they arise, and you challenge the status quo.

jobs.description:

This role reports to the VP Sales and carries end-to-end accountability for the Germany revenue number. Germany is Moss's most established commercial market: 10-12 Account Executives, a strong GTM model with qualified leads, and a product with genuine traction in the SMB segment.

The person joining will be the most visible leadership presence in the market, and will be measured on how quickly they earn the team's respect through commercial credibility, coaching quality, and being genuinely in the weeds on deals.

Your responsibilities

 - Own the Germany revenue number across all Account Executives: conversion rates, deal discipline, average order value, and pipeline health, with a clear mandate to drive a step change in team accountability and urgency.

 - Coach the team directly on live deals: join customer calls, run structured deal reviews, and give specific, actionable feedback that changes how AEs qualify, multi-thread, and close.

 - Diagnose pipeline and performance data to identify where deals stall, where next steps are missing, and where team habits need to change, then translate those findings into concrete processes and targeted interventions.

 - Build and iterate core sales infrastructure: qualification frameworks, mutual action plans, and the weekly coaching cadences the team runs on.

 - Partner with marketing, product, and revenue operations to adapt the go-to-market as Moss's product and customer segmentation evolve, including more complex deal structures and outbound motions ahead.

 - Lead the career and performance conversations the team needs: clear expectations, honest feedback, and visible accountability when the bar is not being met.

About you

 - 4+ years of full-funnel B2B SaaS sales experience in SMB or mid-market (50-500 employees), with clear evidence of quota attainment in a high-volume, high-velocity environment

 - 2+ years leading a direct team of Account Executives with full quota responsibility

 - Demonstrable experience impacting conversion rates, pipeline health, and driving excellent team culture

 - Fluent in German (C2) and English (C1)

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

 - Establishes credibility with a team through deal involvement and coaching quality, not seniority; closes the product knowledge gap fast by leaning in, not waiting to be trained

 - Reads pipeline data with urgency: spots a pattern, forms a hypothesis, tests a fix, and tracks what changes

 - Direct and specific when coaching AEs: concrete feedback on specific deals, not high-level frameworks

 - Brings intrinsic drive and models the accountability and urgency expected of the team

Join our Partnerships team as a Partnerships Manager (f/m/d).  You will play a pivotal role in cultivating long-term relationships with partners and in expanding the channels through which we excite our potential customers for Moss. Through the cross-functional collaboration with internal stakeholders and leveraging your expertise, you will be a key pillar in Moss’ journey to become the European market leader in spend management. 



Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

 - Partner Identification & Assessment - Identify potential partnership opportunities that align with Moss' strategic goals and target markets. Conduct thorough assessments to evaluate the suitability and potential value of prospective partners.

 - Relationship Building - Cultivate and nurture relationships with existing and potential partners. Establish rapport, engage in effective communication, and maintain regular contact to foster strong, mutually beneficial partnerships.

 - Negotiation & Agreement - Lead negotiations with partners to create and finalize agreements, ensuring that commercial terms are beneficial. Collaborate closely with legal and executive teams to ensure contract compliance and risk mitigation.

 - Revenue Generation - Develop and implement strategies to drive revenue growth through partnerships. This may include joint marketing campaigns, co-selling initiatives, and referral programs. Continuously monitor and optimize partnership performance to maximize financial outcomes.

 - Cross-functional Collaboration - Collaborate with various internal teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Support to align partnership activities with Moss' overall business goals. Ensure seamless coordination and communication across departments to execute partnership initiatives effectively.

 - Proven experience in B2B partnership roles or business development in a fast-growing SaaS or financial services company

 - Fluent in German (C2) & English (C1)

 - Trusted partner: you quickly establish strong credibility with partners, identifying synergies to build lasting relationships. 

 - Entrepreneurial Mindset: you are always on the lookout for new partnerships, ready to generate high impact for Moss. You approach lead generation in an efficient and pragmatic way, understanding partners' processes and leveraging insights for joint revenue opportunities. 

 - Ownership: you fully own your tasks, your constant learning progress and partner relationships, proactively overcoming obstacles and ensuring success aligned with broader business goals.

 - Collaborative Spirit: you proactively collaborate within your team, and with internal and external stakeholders to create a best-in-class partner and customer experience.

London, UK

Moss is building its strategic partnerships function from scratch, and this is one of the first two hires shaping it. You'll take target platforms from zero relationship to live, revenue-generating integration, owning the sourcing, business case, and delivery for each one.

 - Navigate complex partner organisations to reach the right decision makers, from founders and C-level contacts at smaller platforms to Heads of Partnerships at larger ones

 - Build the commercial and technical case for each partnership and secure buy-in from both Moss leadership and the partner's stakeholders

 - Own each partnership end-to-end, from an initial referral or lightweight integration through to a live, revenue-generating relationship

 - Partner with Product and Engineering to scope integration requirements and manage delivery against Moss's API and roadmap

 - Collaborate with the Channel team where accounting-platform integrators already exist, to avoid overlap and align on commercialisation

 - Define and adjust your own playbook, prioritising partners by revenue potential and strategic fit as the market picture sharpens

 - 5+ years in business development or partnerships within B2B SaaS, fintech, cloud, or payments

 - At least 2 years specifically in strategic partnerships or integration-led partner roles, having built relationships from scratch rather than managed an existing book

jobs.title: Partnerships Associate Manager - GER
jobs.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We are now looking for a Partnerships Associate to support our growth journey in Germany. This is a junior-level role designed for early-career professionals with a strong interest in finance, accounting, or Fintech. You’ll help identify and connect with potential partners, build a strong pipeline, and support the foundation for lasting cosmmercial relationships. Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to develop into a full-cycle Partner Manager role, taking end-to-end ownership of strategic partnerships.

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

 - Partner Identification & Assessment: Research and identify prospective partners aligned with Moss’ strategic priorities and ideal customer profiles. Support the initial assessment of partners through qualitative and quantitative analysis (e.g., partner fit, customer base, integration potential).

 - Outreach & Pipeline Building: Own the top of the funnel for our partnerships pipeline. Proactively reach out to prospective partners via email, LinkedIn, events, and other channels. Engage partners with a clear value proposition and qualify initial interest.

 - Relationship Building & Support: Assist in building and maintaining strong working relationships with partners. Participate in partner calls and meetings, prepare follow-ups, and support ongoing communication. Help deliver value to partners by understanding their needs and coordinating with internal teams.

 - Process & Reporting: Track outreach and pipeline activity in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce). Share regular updates on partner funnel status and help improve outreach playbooks and processes. Collaborate with Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to ensure partner prospects are well aligned with Moss’ commercial strategy.
   

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in this role:

 - First experience (1-2 years of full-time work) in business development, partnerships, finance, accounting, or Fintech

 - Academic background in business, finance, economics, or similar fields

 - Fluent in German (C2) & English (C1)  

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

 - Curious & Analytical: You’re structured in your research and bring insights into conversations.

 - Relationship— Oriented: You enjoy speaking to people, understand how to build rapport, and communicate with clarity.

 - Self-Starter: You take initiative, manage your own pipeline, and are eager to learn from every interaction.

 - Team Player: You collaborate closely with teammates and internal stakeholders to deliver joint results.

 - Growth-Driven: You’re looking to grow into a Partner Manager role over time and want to learn how to build high-impact commercial partnerships.

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets.
